summary: DV2 is DataVita's city-centre Glasgow colocation facility, located in the basement of the HFD Group office development at 177 Bothwell Street in the International Financial Services District. Directory listings describe roughly 1,000 sq m of space, about 130 racks and ~1 MW of power, built to a Tier III design. DataVita is wholly owned by HFD Group and also operates the larger DV1 campus in Lanarkshire (recorded separately).
maturity_explanation: Actively marketed operating facility on DataVita's own website and third-party directories as of July 2026.
unknowns: Year DV2 opened (the host building at 177 Bothwell Street completed circa 2022; DV2 opening date not separately confirmed)
Whether the ~1 MW figure is IT load or gross power
Formal Uptime Institute certification status (marketed as 'Tier III design')
